use_case: Pricing and personalized offers engine: dynamic online prices within plus or minus 15% of shelf price, and weekly personalized digital coupons for loyalty members
vendor_or_model: Pricing engine SaaS vendor (machine learning demand and recommendation models)
data_categories: Loyalty purchase history; home ZIP code; delivery zone; item cost, shelf price, stock, and sales velocity
consequential_decision_category: None (retail prices and offers; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Manager sets bounds, cost floor, and exclusions; reviews daily exceptions; can freeze online prices to shelf prices; monthly fairness review by the General Manager
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (N44-45-R02); Fla. Stat. 501.160 price gouging during declared emergencies; privacy notice commitments
status: In production; approved with conditions 2026-09-04 (delivery-zone factor disabled 2026-08-28)

use_case: Generative AI assistant for product descriptions and ad copy
data_categories: Product and promotion information only; no customer, loyalty, or employee data
human_in_the_loop: Staff edit every draft; claims reviewed under POL-01 4.12 before publication
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) (claims in generated copy) (N44-45-R02)
status: Approved 2026-09-04 for use without customer data (POL-05 4.11)
